conventions.yield: annual nominal decimal compounded at coupon frequency
conventions.settlement: cash flows strictly after settlement are included
conventions.schedule: unadjusted regular schedule generated backwards from maturity with end-of-month preservation
conventions.accruedInterest: coupon per period multiplied by elapsed regular-period fraction
conventions.dirtyPrice: present value of contractual cash flows per 100 nominal
conventions.cleanPrice: dirty price minus accrued interest per 100 nominal
conventions.positionRisk: long=+1, short=-1; monetary values scale by notional/100
conventions.shock: parallel yield shock in basis points with exact repricing and duration-convexity approximation

limitations: Educational fixed-rate bullet bonds only; no calls, puts, sinking funds, amortisation, floating coupons or inflation linkage.
Coupon schedules are regular and unadjusted; holiday calendars, settlement lags, business-day conventions and irregular stubs are outside v1.
A single yield-to-maturity discounts every cash flow; this is not a curve, z-spread, OAS or credit valuation model.
Taxes, fees, default, recovery and liquidity are not modeled.
